newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Harbor spot jet diffs dive on ample barrels.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Harbor spot jet diffs dive on ample barrels.

text.p: New York Harbor jet fuel differentials fell sharply Monday under pressure from ample supplies coming off the Colonial Pipeline, traders said.
NYH prompt 54-grade jet fuel changed hands at 0.50 cents over the June NYMEX futures, more than 0.50 cent off Friday's level and about 1.00 cent down from a week ago.

"We're seeing a lot of barrels coming up the Colonial Pipeline," one Harbor player said, which has forced sellers to lower their offers. The Colonial Pipeline connects the Gulf Coast's "Refinery Row" with the East Coast.
NYH prompt 55-grade low sulphur jet fuel traded at 1.25 cents over the June NYMEX, according to traders.
However, the U.S. Gulf jet differentials showed no movement in thin market activity, with players quoting prompt 54-grade barrels between 1.00 and 1.25 cents under the June NYMEX.
On the NYMEX, June heating oil futures fell 0.55 cent to settle at 57.92 cents a gallon.
